_note: Tier 2, oldest end. 25-28 October 2025: martial law imagery, the Vatican mothership, the scorpion tail.

mentions.claim_text: He describes troops in fatigues going through the streets in humvees and army vehicles, barbed wire blocking off certain blocks, and military brigades and blockages in major cities.
mentions.quote: I saw bobwire fence being blocked off in certain blocks
mentions.falsify_match: Troops and wire cordons controlling movement in American cities.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Federal deployments to DC and Los Angeles in 2025 did not include cordons of this kind.

mentions.claim_text: He says people were trying to reach rural areas and the countryside to get away, relocating to places without many people, and names Oklahoma.
mentions.quote: People were trying to go to rural areas to get away
mentions.falsify_match: Internal migration out of cities driven by unrest.
mentions.falsify_miss: None on that scale. Rural relocation has been a standing theme in the corpus since 2023.

mentions.claim_text: He says that had the other candidate won they would already be on that road, and that he saw Trump as a log in the road to the elite plan for a global takeover.
mentions.quote: I SAW Trump being a log in the road to the plan of the elite
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: a counterfactual about an election that did not happen, plus an obstruction claim with no test.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cannot fail.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying he can delay it but will not stop it altogether, that he is buying them time.
mentions.quote: he can delay it but he will not stop it altogether
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: delay without cancellation means no date can ever expire.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cannot fail. This is the clearest statement in the corpus of why the dated claims cannot be scored against him on his own terms.

mentions.claim_text: He asks how safe it is, says there are people who want to cause mass confusion in the nation, and that they are praying against Republicans he calls rhinos.
mentions.quote: we got people that want to cause mass confusion in the nation
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition about domestic politics.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He describes young people in white t-shirts holding glory worship events, with radical conversions among the young.
mentions.quote: THEY HAD WHITE T-SHIRTS AND THEY ARE HAVING worship events
mentions.falsify_match: A youth revival movement with the visual signature described.
mentions.falsify_miss: None appears. Undated.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying the fun has just begun about restoring the fountain of wealth, and asks prayer for great discernment each day.
mentions.quote: The fun has just begun
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: a fountain of wealth restored, with no recipient, amount or date.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cannot fail.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a massive mothership hovering over the Vatican, comparing it to the craft in Independence Day.
mentions.quote: I saw it hovering over the Vatican. It looked like a flying mothership
mentions.falsify_match: A large unexplained craft appearing over the Vatican.
mentions.falsify_miss: None appears. A named place and an unmistakable event, which makes this among the most checkable claims in the corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He says it will freak everybody out, corrects himself from speed of light to speed of sound, and calls what he saw a demonic thing.
mentions.quote: I do not say the speed of light, it is speed of sound
mentions.falsify_match: The craft moving at the speed described.
mentions.falsify_miss: None appears. The self-correction is recorded because it narrows the claim rather than widening it.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is not coincidence and the Lord is warning about what is to come, and that he was shown a great shaking coming to Canada.
mentions.quote: the Lord showed me great shaking coming to Canada
mentions.falsify_match: A major upheaval in Canada.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Shaking has no threshold.

mentions.claim_text: He says the bear is getting poked and that they are about to see Putin with Apollyon influencing him, running around him like a Tasmanian devil.
mentions.quote: the bear is getting poked
mentions.falsify_match: A Russian escalation attributed to provocation.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The spirit influencing him has no observable signature.

mentions.claim_text: He says what they are about to see on Saturday is adults having a tantrum because they did not get their free stuff, and that he has seen it and it will be bad.
mentions.quote: It is a bunch of adults having a tantrum
mentions.falsify_match: Serious disorder at the Saturday demonstrations, 1 November 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: The day passes without it. The Saturday is dated by context, which makes this scoreable.

mentions.claim_text: He describes burning cars, looting, and Nordstrom and Macy stores ransacked and burned.
mentions.quote: burning up Nordstroms and burning up Macys
mentions.falsify_match: Named department stores burned in American riots.
mentions.falsify_miss: None burned. Naming the retailers is what makes it checkable.

mentions.claim_text: He says weather weaponisation and warfare extend to low pressure systems and cyclone-like weather manipulation for snow.
mentions.quote: weather manipulation for snow
mentions.falsify_match: Evidence of engineered winter storms.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Cloud seeding exists but cannot produce cyclones.

mentions.claim_text: After a passage of tongues he says Buffalo, New York is highlighted to him.
mentions.quote: I see Buffalo, New York is highlighted to me
mentions.falsify_match: A significant event at Buffalo.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A named city with nothing attached, though Buffalo is a specific enough choice to be worth keeping.

mentions.claim_text: He says to pray against ice storms including long track ice storms, and in the most unlikely places rather than only up north.
mentions.quote: Pray against long long track ice storms
mentions.falsify_match: A long track ice storm in an unusual location.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Widening it to unlikely places removes the geography that would have made it checkable.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the storm on a map in light pink going to dark pink and dark purple, starting in the Kentucky area and running clear into Alabama.
mentions.quote: a long track ice storm that started and went clear into Alabama
mentions.falsify_match: A long track ice storm from Kentucky into Alabama.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Two named states and a track direction, which is the checkable version of the ice storm word.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees something trying to break down the peace agreement in Gaza, repeating the word rift, and America trying to strong-arm.
mentions.quote: trying to break down the peace agreement in the Gaza
mentions.falsify_match: The October 2025 Gaza agreement breaking down under American pressure.
mentions.falsify_miss: It holds. Given three weeks after the agreement took effect.

mentions.claim_text: He says America tried to strong-arm Israel because of outside pressure, and that he sees the vice president and the Trumps under pressure.
mentions.quote: America tried to strong-arm Israel
mentions.falsify_match: Public American pressure on Israel over the agreement.
mentions.falsify_miss: None applied.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a dividing wall with a big wave of the sea coming, breaking between the United States and Israel, in three stages.
mentions.quote: you got the big wave coming. But it was a three stage
mentions.falsify_match: A three-stage breach between America and Israel.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The count of three stages is the checkable element.

mentions.claim_text: Speaking prophetically he names a chosen voice and says there will be a major voice in Australia able to stand against political pressure.
mentions.quote: there will be a major voice in Australia
mentions.falsify_match: A prominent Australian religious voice emerging under political pressure.
mentions.falsify_miss: None emerges. Unnamed.

mentions.claim_text: He says Canada and Australia are the scorpion tail and that the Lord told him great persecution comes to those two places.
mentions.quote: This is the scorpion tail. These two places great persecution
mentions.falsify_match: State persecution of Christians in Canada and Australia.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Two named countries, which makes it checkable.

mentions.claim_text: He says the scorpion tail is the one in England, marked, running over Canada and to Australia and New Zealand.
mentions.quote: It is the one in England. And this is the scorpion tail
mentions.falsify_match: A pattern of persecution running from England through the Commonwealth.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Four named countries.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will start stripping away freedoms to get people ready, using the virus, that it is all pre-planned to bring in the beast system.
mentions.quote: They are going to start stripping away peoples freedoms. With the virus
mentions.falsify_match: Freedoms curtailed under a public health emergency as a step toward a control system.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Undated, and pre-planned is not something evidence could establish either way.

mentions.claim_text: He opens saying he has things on his heart to talk about and that the Lord spoke to him that day.
mentions.quote: I have some things on my heart to talk to you all about
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: session framing.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says each continent will produce a different sound in the coming move because of its culture, with different levels of it.
mentions.quote: Each sound will be different on each continent
mentions.falsify_match: Distinct regional worship movements emerging.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. No threshold and no date.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is dividing and getting his alliances in order, that he has a plan, and that he sees all his key chess pieces being moved around.
mentions.quote: he has all his key chess pieces he is moving around
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: an unnamed actor arranging unnamed alliances.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cannot fail.

mentions.claim_text: He says people will be thankful for where they live, names the central part of America as where he is, and says great change is coming.
mentions.quote: You will be so thankful you live where you live
mentions.falsify_match: The interior of America proving safer than the coasts in a crisis.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Great change has no threshold.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw people leaving New York, Los Angeles and Chicago, going south to find security and rural land.
mentions.quote: I saw them leaving New York and they were leaving LA
mentions.falsify_match: Net migration out of those three cities toward the south and rural areas.
mentions.falsify_miss: None on the scale described. All three cities had been losing population since 2020, which lowers the bar.
